services.name: Starz
services._include_channels_note: Starz through Amazon, Apple TV or Roku is the same Starz library (some titles are only listed there).

services.name: Tubi
services._free_note: Free with ads: TMDB lists it under ads/free, not subscription (flatrate).

refresh._full_refresh_note: Full rebuild on the first scheduled run at or after this hour each day (UTC: 10 = 5:17 AM Eastern in winter, 6:17 AM in summer). Also read by app.js (FULL_UTC_HOUR).
refresh._well_known_pages_by_service_note: Big catalogs go deeper: top 200 most-rated TV shows on Netflix and Hulu (20 per page).
refresh._genre_lists_note: Extra most-rated lists per service for genres that get fewer ratings than dramas, so famous ones were missed (TMDB genre ids: 99 Documentary, 10764 Reality, TV only). Optional `sort_by` and `days` (released in the last N days) make a recent list, e.g. the most popular documentaries of the last year, which are too new for the most-rated list.
refresh._recent_lists_note: Best-known recent releases per service (released in the last `years` years, or between `years` and `after_years` years ago, most-rated first; separate lists so older titles don't push newer ones out). Recent movies were falling between the other lists: no longer new, not in this week's top 40, and not yet as rated as older classics.
refresh._recent_note: Titles released in the last recent_window_days that are still missing a critic score are rechecked every recent_recheck_days days (others monthly).

rotation._note: Titles passed over on the home rows make room for others. Counted in days (once per day seen). Counted per row. From the start_day-th day a title is seen in a row, it moves down places_per_day places per day in that row (every title, liked and saved too); it resets after reset_days days unseen there.
